d:
Desi Melodies is proud to present ‘Bijlee Bijlee’, a song that brings back the Punjabi-pop sound that Harrdy Sandhu originally pioneered and marks his reunion with Jaani, Arvindr Khaira, and BPraak after three long years. Debuting with her first-ever music video, Palak Tiwari is seen opposite Harrdy showcasing her celestial looks along with her stupendous dance moves.
Starring - Harrdy Sandhu, Palak Tiwari, and Armen Greyg
Singer - Harrdy Sandhu
Music - B Praak
Lyrics and Composer - Jaani
Director - Arvindr Khaira
DOP - Anurag Solanki
Editor - Adele Pereira
